comanche:
Comanche indexer configuration directory.

This directory is hidden and will not appear in the index.

JSON uses the format "key":"value".
- The key must be the full relative path from index.php.
- Example: "test/file.txt":"Description here".

Rules:
- Strings must use double quotes.
- Escape quotes inside text with \".
- Use \n for line breaks.
- Do not add a comma after the last entry.
- Paths are case-sensitive and must match exactly.
index.php: Comanche indexer, also hidden. As this is the last entry, there is no trailing comma.
